# Spaze Invaders

Space Invaders for the TI-84 Plus CE. Original TI-83 version by Hannes Edfeldt; TI-84 Plus CSE and CE ports by James Vernon (JamesV).
Files are the unmodified release v1.0.2 from https://www.ticalc.org/pub/84plusce/asm/games/spaze.zip. The author's readme.txt is kept alongside, as its licence requires:

"This program is of course freeware and you may freely distribute it as long as all of the files (spaze.8xp and readme.txt) are included and not modified in any way."
